title: Monday's Child Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Monday's Child is a prime Seaside home with renovated bathrooms and kitchen throughout. Features a generous wrap around porch w/outdoor dining and lounge seating! Walk to over 35 shops & restaurants steps from front door! Prime Seaside Proper Location!
description_expanded: Description11 Savannah Street3 QUEENS, 1 BUNK BED (maximum sleeping is 8) Welcome to Monday’s Child | Seaside Proper on 30AMonday’s Child boasts one of the most sought-after locations in Seaside Proper, situated on Savannah Street just 75 feet from beach access with slight Gulf views from the second-floor balcony. Positioned directly across from the beach and only two blocks from the Seaside Amphitheater and downtown Seaside, this home places more than 35 restaurants, shops, and community events within easy walking distance from your front door.Prime Savannah Street Location Near the Beach & Town CenterFacing Scenic Highway 30A, Monday’s Child offers a true front-row Seaside experience. From here, you’re steps from the sugar-white sand and emerald waters of the Gulf and just a short stroll to the heart of Seaside, where guests can enjoy outdoor concerts, Friday night movies under the stars, the Saturday Farmers Market, and vibrant dining and shopping options.Wraparound Porch & Outdoor Living SpacesThe expansive wraparound front porch is surrounded by lush landscaping, offering privacy and multiple outdoor living areas. This inviting space includes an outdoor dining table for six—perfect for alfresco meals—an adjacent lounge area, and four rocking chairs ideal for morning coffee or evening wine. Just off the porch, a large charcoal grill makes afternoon cookouts easy after a day at the beach.Open-Concept Living with Renovated KitchenEntry is through the porch into the first-floor open-concept living area, combining comfortable living, dining, and a newly renovated kitchen. The kitchen features quartz countertops, custom-built cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a large double-door refrigerator with water and ice dispenser, a five-burner electric cooktop, and a central stainless steel island—designed to keep everyone connected while meals are prepared.The adjacent dining area comfortably seats six and flows seamlessly into the living room, which features a large built-in bay window perfect for afternoon reading. Plush seating includes a three-seat sofa, loveseat, and club chair, all arranged around a large flat-screen TV. Natural light fills the space through double doors that open directly onto the wraparound porch.First-Floor Bedrooms & Family-Friendly LayoutThe first floor includes two queen bedrooms, each with its own private, newly renovated bathroom.The queen primary bedroom features ample closet space and an en-suite bath with a single vanity, quartz countertops, and a tub/shower combination.The second queen bedroom is ideal for families, offering a custom built-in twin bunk, closet storage, and a renovated en-suite bathroom with a single vanity, quartz counters, and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower.Bonus Loft & Gulf-View BalconyJust off the main living area, stairs lead to a second-floor bonus loft featuring an additional queen bed and access to an open-air balcony. This private perch offers slight Gulf views and is the perfect spot to enjoy Seaside’s Fourth of July or New Year’s Eve fireworks from the comfort of home.Extra Conveniences for a Seamless StayAdditional amenities include an outdoor shower at the rear of the home—perfect for rinsing off after sandy beach days—and a stackable full-size washer and dryer for added convenience during your stay.A True Seaside FavoriteWith its unbeatable Seaside Proper location, wraparound porch, thoughtful renovations, and proximity to both the beach and downtown Seaside, Monday’s Child is a longtime family favorite. Just 75 feet from the beach and only a three-minute walk to the Seaside Amphitheater, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, charm, and classic 30A living.Need additional space, check out the rear guest cottage Sea For Two that is a queen guest cottage that comfortably sleeps two more!* 5 night minimum Spring, Spring Break and Summer; 3 night minimum Fall; 2 night minimum Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration.FEATURES1,186 square feet of comfortable coastal livingPrivate Seaside residential beach access: Savannah Beach PavilionBeach proximity: Approximately a 1-minute walk (75 feet) to accessParking: Private driveway for convenient parkingUpdated interiors: Kitchen and bathrooms renovated in 2022Laundry: Washer and dryer on-siteOutdoor cooking: Grill available for guest usePeacock Alley Linens: Fresh, luxurious sheets and towels throughout the homeSeaside amenities access: 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts (court fees apply), 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fully equipped fitness centerWelcome tote includes: Two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes (pickup at the Seaside Transit Authority)Guest services: Personalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking & golf cart policy: Two parking passes issued for two-bedroom and larger homes; golf carts are considered a vehicle and count toward parking limits; golf carts are prohibited for non-homeowners visiting Seaside; special circumstance requests require an approved permitNo pets permittedSTR23-002360
